Summary.Description: Host registrations and observed operation plans.

States.NoFilteredPlans: No observed plans match the current filters.
States.SelectPlan: Select an observed plan to inspect its applied behavior chain.
States.NoAppliedBehaviors: No behaviors were applied to this ready plan. Its operation is connected directly to the terminal handler.
States.PlanBuilding: This snapshot captured a plan whose behavior chain was still being constructed. Refresh the catalog to see its latest materialization state.

Filters.SearchPlaceholder: Search by operation, component, behavior, source module, contract, or method

Plans.Title: Observed operation plans
Plans.OverviewDescription: Execution-boundary policy, callable types, and the times this cached plan was constructed.
Plans.DetailDescription: Positions describe the chain from outermost to innermost. Configured order controls candidate sorting.
Plans.TerminalDescription: When invoked, the operation reaches its entry method if preceding behaviors continue. A behavior can short-circuit the chain.

Registrations.Title: Registered behaviors
Registrations.Description: Candidate behaviors registered in this host, sorted by configured order and type. Inclusion in a plan depends on type matching and descriptor filters; this catalog does not record exclusion reasons.

Diagnostics.Title: Developer diagnostics
Diagnostics.Description: Exact identities for support and correlation. Copy the plan and operation keys, assembly-qualified types, and method signature together.
Diagnostics.ExactTypeHelp: Exact assembly-qualified CLR identity used to disambiguate types in advanced diagnostics.
Diagnostics.ExactMethodHelp: Exact method signature paired with its assembly-scoped declaring type.

Summary.Registrations: Total behavior registrations in this host; one registration may apply to many operations.
Summary.Plans: Distinct execution plans observed through execution or explicit inspection and cached by this host.
Summary.ExecutionPoints: Distinct execution-boundary categories represented by observed plans, such as event handling or hosted-service start.
Summary.Faults: Plans whose behavior chain failed to materialize; the failure is cached for the current host lifetime.

Concepts.ExecutionPoint: Stable subsystem boundary where the operation enters the pipeline, such as eventbus.distributed-handler.
Concepts.BusinessOperation: Whether the adapter marks this execution as application business work; behaviors may use it as an applicability filter.
Concepts.TransactionMode: Whether the boundary allows the registered unit-of-work behavior to wrap the whole execution automatically; None still permits explicit transactions.
Concepts.PlanStatus: Behavior-chain state: Building is matching, Ready has an available chain, and Faulted has a cached materialization error.
Concepts.BehaviorOrder: Configured sort value; lower values are placed farther outside in the chain, with type identity breaking ties deterministically.
Concepts.Lifetime: Dependency-injection lifetime of the behavior instance: Singleton, Scoped, or Transient.
Concepts.Source: Monica module that contributed the registration; Application / host means direct host registration.

Plans.OperationName: Readable operation name derived from the invoked component and entry method.
Plans.BehaviorCount: Number of behaviors actually applied after type matching and descriptor filtering.
Plans.PlanId: Compact deterministic identifier for this policy-specific execution plan.
Plans.OperationId: Compact deterministic identifier for the underlying execution operation.
Plans.PlanKey: Canonical cache identity composed of the operation key, business flag, and transaction mode; intended for diagnostics.
Plans.OperationKey: Canonical machine identity built from the execution point, assembly-scoped types, and method signature.
Plans.Component: Concrete or contractual component type invoked at this execution boundary.
Plans.Contract: Interface used by the adapter to locate the entry method; unavailable for direct method boundaries.
Plans.Method: Concrete method invoked by this execution boundary.
Plans.Input: Type passed into the execution pipeline and its behaviors.
Plans.Result: Result type returned by the behavior chain; no-result operations use an internal placeholder type.
Plans.StartedAt: Time behavior-plan materialization started, not the business operation start time.
Plans.CompletedAt: Time behavior-plan materialization completed or faulted, not the business operation completion time.
Plans.AppliedChain: Matched behaviors in the cached plan, ordered outermost to innermost. This is not an invocation log; behaviors may short-circuit before reaching the terminal handler.
Plans.BehaviorPosition: One-based position of the behavior in the final applied chain.
Plans.ResolvedType: Concrete behavior type resolved for this operation; open generics appear as their closed type.
Plans.RegisteredType: Behavior type originally registered with the host; it may be open generic.
Plans.Fault: Deterministic error raised while materializing this operation's behavior chain; cached for the host lifetime.
Plans.ExceptionType: .NET exception type that caused plan materialization to fail.

Registrations.Behavior: Candidate behavior implementation; it enters a plan only after input/result matching and descriptor filtering.
Registrations.OpenGeneric: Whether the behavior is registered as a generic type definition and closed using the operation's input and result types.
Registrations.DescriptorFilter: Whether an additional applicability predicate uses metadata such as execution point or business classification.

Pipeline.Title: Execution pipeline
Pipeline.SinceTip: When the earliest plan was first observed. The catalog lives in this host process and starts empty at each restart.
Pipeline.RefreshFailed: Refresh failed. Showing the last good snapshot.
Pipeline.LoadFailedTitle: The execution pipeline catalog could not be loaded
Pipeline.LoadFailed: The catalog facade returned no snapshot. Retry while the host is running; if it keeps failing, look for “Failed to build the execution-pipeline catalog snapshot” in the host log.
Pipeline.Stale: The refresh at {0} did not complete. This is still the snapshot from {1}; operations first run after it are missing.
Pipeline.DisplayTip: Faulted or stalled plans. Every call to their operation fails or waits.
Pipeline.FaultedOne: {0} cannot run: its plan faulted with {1}, and every call rethrows it until the host restarts.
Pipeline.FaultedMany: {0} plans faulted, including {1} with {2}; every call to them fails until the host restarts.
Pipeline.Stalled: {0} has been building its chain for {1}. Construction normally takes milliseconds, so every call to it is waiting.
Pipeline.Building: {0} was still building at capture; refresh to read its chain.
Pipeline.Calm: All {0} observed plans are ready; each operation reaches its handler through {1}–{2} behaviors.
Pipeline.UnusedClosed: {0} is in none of them: it is a closed type, so it matches only an operation with exactly its input and result types.
Pipeline.UnusedOpen: {0} is in none of the ready plans; a descriptor filter or generic constraints can exclude an operation.
Pipeline.Caveat: Only operations this host has run or inspected since {0} are listed.
Pipeline.SearchPlaceholder: Operation, component, contract, method, behavior or ID
Pipeline.MatrixD: Each line runs from the caller through the behaviors applied in its plan to the operation's handler. Columns are the registered behaviors, outermost first.
Pipeline.MatrixLabel: Behavior chain matrix of observed plans
Pipeline.LegendJoin: Joins an open unit of work only (transaction mode None)
Pipeline.ReadoutIdle: Point at a chain or a behavior column for its exact reading; arrow keys move between rows and Enter opens a plan.
Pipeline.ReadoutPlan: {0}: {1} of {2} registered behaviors applied, transaction mode {3}.
Pipeline.ReadoutFaulted: {0}: plan faulted with {1}; there is no chain.
Pipeline.ReadoutBuilding: {0}: building for {1}; the chain is not available yet.
Pipeline.CaveatNote: A plan appears only after its operation first runs or is inspected. Operations that have not run are absent, so “not applied” describes observed plans only.
Pipeline.NoPlans: This host has not executed or inspected any operation since it started. Each operation's plan appears here the first time it runs; the {0} registered behaviors above are the candidates.
Pipeline.NoRegistrations: No execution behaviors are registered. Ready plans reach their handler directly.
Pipeline.NoMatch: No observed plan matches these filters.
Pipeline.FaultBody: Every call to this operation rethrows this exception before any behavior or the handler runs. The failure stays cached until the host restarts: fix the behavior registration or the operation's metadata, then restart the host.
Pipeline.StalledBody: This plan has been building for {0}. Construction normally completes within milliseconds, so a descriptor filter may be blocked; every call to the operation waits on it.
Pipeline.BuildingBody: This plan was still building when the snapshot was taken. Refresh the catalog to read its chain.
Pipeline.ChainNote: Outermost first. This is the cached plan, not an invocation log; a behavior can end the call before the handler.
Pipeline.ClosedOver: Open generic behaviors are closed over {0} → {1}.
Pipeline.JoinOnly: Transaction mode is None: this behavior joins a unit of work only when the caller already opened one, and opens none itself.
Pipeline.NoChain: This plan is ready but applies no behavior; the call reaches the handler directly.
Pipeline.ExcludedTitle: Registered but not in this plan
Pipeline.ExcludedClosed: A closed type matches only its own input and result types, and this operation's types differ.
Pipeline.ExcludedOpen: Generic constraints exclude this operation's input or result type.
Pipeline.ExcludedFilter: Its descriptor filter or type match excluded this operation; the catalog does not record which.

TxExplain.Automatic: The unit of work wraps the whole execution, then saves and commits on normal completion.
TxExplain.None: No automatic unit of work; UnitOfWork joins one only if the caller already opened it.

Pipeline.FirstNote: When this host first ran or inspected the operation; construction starts then. It is not the business operation's start time.
Pipeline.DiagnosticsD: Exact identities for support and correlation.
Pipeline.RelatedD: These plans share a display name. Compare their types and execution boundaries to tell them apart.
Pipeline.UnknownPlanTitle: This plan is not in the catalog
Pipeline.UnknownPlan: Plan {0} is not in this host's catalog. A catalog belongs to one host process and starts empty at each restart, so the link may come from another host or an earlier process.
Pipeline.ByPointD: Derived from observed plans; read its filter's reach from the split.
Pipeline.OpenGeneric: Open generic, closed over each operation's input and result types
Pipeline.ClosedType: Closed type, matching only its own input and result types
Pipeline.FilterYes: Yes: metadata such as the execution point or business flag decides whether it applies
Pipeline.SourceNote: The catalog reports no contributing module for this registration; the assembly is the nearest provenance.
Pipeline.ZeroClosed: No observed plan includes it. As a closed type it appears only after an operation with exactly its input and result types runs.
Pipeline.ZeroOpen: No ready plan includes it. A descriptor filter or generic constraints can exclude an operation.
Pipeline.UnknownBehavior: This host has no registration named {0}.
Pipeline.ReadoutCellJoin: {0} is in the chain of {1}, joining an open unit of work only.
